actions.text: Committee on Energy and Natural Resources. Ordered to be reported with an amendment in the nature of a substitute favorably.
Committee on Energy and Natural Resources. Hearings held.
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources. (Sponsor introductory remarks on measure: CR S4521)

dimensions.assessment: Affects state and local water agencies, Indian Tribes, irrigation districts, and participants in Reclamation States.
dimensions.evidence: located in a Reclamation State... constructed, operated, and maintained by a State, Indian Tribe, irrigation district, water district, or other organization

dimensions.assessment: Modifies federal cost-share caps (up to 25 percent) and establishes competitive advanced pilot technology grants.
dimensions.evidence: participate in an eligible desalination project in an amount equal to not more than 25 percent of the total cost

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes federal participation up to 25 percent of project costs without a project cost cap, and establishes competitive grant funding.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary shall not impose any dollar limitation on participation in an eligible desalination project under this subparagraph.

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Water Infrastructure Improvements for the Nation Act and the Water Desalination Act of 1996 by updating program authorities and adding advanced pilot grants.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Water Infrastructure Improvements for the Nation Act and the Water Desalination Act of 1996 to reauthorize certain desalination programs

dimensions.assessment: Extends program durations and authorizes project expirations for 15 years following enactment across eligible regions.
dimensions.evidence: projects carried out under paragraph (2) of section 4(a) of the Water Desalination Act of 1996... which shall expire on the date that is 15 years after that date of enactment.

missing_information: Total dollar amounts authorized for appropriations
Specific number of projects that will receive grants
importance_detail.rationale: Reauthorizes desalination programs through fiscal year 2033, adjusts cost-sharing limits, and creates advanced pilot technology grant programs.
